capabilities: Turn notes into a website with ready-made themes
Pick themes for docs, blogs, resumes, landing pages and slides
Self-host an MDFriday server via a one-command Docker install
extras: Covers two plugins: MDFriday Publish and MDFriday Sync. Existing paying users can apply for one free year of the new service. Detailed docs, configuration and troubleshooting live outside the README, with video tutorials on Bilibili and YouTube.
problem: Obsidian notes stay local, and turning a vault into a shareable, styled website normally requires setting up a static site generator separately.
summary: Notes-to-website publisher that turns Markdown notes into themed websites, with a companion component that syncs the vault across devices.
